title: Ex-Prosecutor Charged With Treason in Mexico Over US Drug Raid
detail: BBC reported on Oct 21, 2026 that a former prosecutor has been charged with treason in Mexico in connection with a US drug raid. This follows the Oct 19 detention of ex-Chihuahua prosecutor César Jáuregui and the FGR treason probe tied to CIA agents in Mexico.

media.caption: Ex-prosecutor charged with treason in Mexico over US drug raid

title: Sheinbaum: federal funds for Jalisco water works; no deal to buy more US gas
detail: At her Oct 21 conference Sheinbaum said the federal government will contribute to water projects in Jalisco after meeting Conagua's director, seeking funding that avoids new debt. She said there is no agreement or commitment to buy more natural gas from the US, an idea raised in the context of the trade deficit. Coverage also noted Pemex debt reduction and the fiscal huachicol crackdown.
